batting.name: VVS Laxman
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b PP Chawla

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c K Goel b PP Chawla

batting.name: Shahid Afridi
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b Gagandeep Singh

batting.name: SB Bangar
batting.dismissal: c S Sreesanth b PP Chawla

batting.name: D Kalyankrishna
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b IK Pathan

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b D Kalyankrishna

balls.text: not to be, as Sharma walks right across to expose all the stumps, trying to scoop it away but instead running a leg-bye to short third man
full on the stumps, RP makes room and slashes past backward point
loses a hand off the bat but still clips the full ball over square leg
massive! Sharma, take a bow! Judges the length, transfers the weight, and sends this one rows back over cow corner for another six
makes room and drives just over a leaping cover fielder's fingertips, Sharma wanted to come back for two but RP sent him back, wisely

oh well held, Marsh! Brilliant effort at backward point, diving horizontally to his right to cup a firm slash from Kalyankrishna, dancing down the track, perfectly balanced in the air ... one for the album, I'd say
what an over! This time he slams the length delivery flat over mid-on!
and he just rolls on, stepping across and scooping over short fine leg
uff! Sharma! He just skips down and drills this dead straight over the umpire, it missed taking off his head by inches

slogs this one miles into the air, getting too much under it, but survives as Pomersbach fails to cling on with an excellent dive running forward from long-off, then he fires in a good throw to Sangakkara, but replays show Sharma was just in
makes room and goes over extra-cover but its not timed well, landing safely between three fielders converging on the boundary
full on off stump, Kalyankrishna slashes it over backward point
he gets four, moving to fifty from just 34 balls! He gets back and heaves the ball just over midwicket, picking his spot excellently, to get the fans on their feet
repeat of that shot, except this time Sharma calls his partner down and survives as Sangakkara misses with the under-arm flick to the stumps
full outside off, Kalyankrishna backs away and isn't able to connect
too full and he drives along the ground to the long-off fielder
makes more room and carves the full delivery over backward point, it drops safely and then turns away from the sweeper, who recovers very well
skips down, slashes upwards of gully down to third man, on the bounce
another flowing shot, this time the other side as Sreesanth gives Sharma room and he drives him on the up over extra cover, stunning stuff from the young man
top shot, Sreesanth erring in length and Sharma pulling past midwicket
now its a low full toss and he connects, on-driving past Sharma
changes the length and its the same result, the ball hitting the seam and beating the bat as the tail-ender makes room and feels for it outside off stump
swing and a miss, feet not moving as he swishes at a full one
and he strikes first ball, landing it on a full length right in the zone and Zoysa misses all ends up with a nothing shot, middle stump is uprooted
four more! Sharma is turning it on, just clearing the front leg and drilling this one back over Gagandeep's head, again one bounce and over the ropes
steps out and converts it into a full toss, shuffling and hammering wide of mid-on and midwicket for a one-bounce four, well played
another one in that zone but Sharma escapes by just squeezing bat on it and running it to short third man
and again, yorker on the stumps and its dug out back to the bowler
starts to walk across and the bowler fires it in on a yorker length, Sharma just manages to jam bat down on it, very well bowled
on a length and he drives on the up, failing to beat the man at cover
flatter on off stump, he plays a classy extra-cover drive for one
and thats bigger and better! Chawla serves up a full toss and Sharma duly lets that fly rows back over long-on for half a dozen, cleanly struck
good blow, Sharma getting down and slogging over mid-on for four
well flighted on off stump, spins away and he defends off the front foot, just wide of slip and backward point
full outside off stump and thats driven hard to the man at mid-off

another one goes! Bangar skips down and tries to hit Chawla over long-on but isn't to the pitch and so doesn't middle it, so Sreesanth comes in and dives forward to hold a good catch, handing Chawla his third
full on the pads, Bangar uses his feet and drives past midwicket
back of a length, he half-pushes it back to Gagandeep's right, safely wide, and the ball rolls down towards mid-on for a single
straight on the stumps, Sharma walks across and clips out to the deep and calls for the two
comes onto the front foot and drives again, this time edging along the ground to the fielder at third man
closer to the stumps, driven off the front foot to extra cover
good length just outside off and he runs it to a sliding backward point
tossed up and he kneels down to slog that past midwicket, well hit
a touch shorter, he gets back and drives to the man at cover
flatter one outside the line, he drives and misses as Chawla appeals

madness! Chawla beats the batsman with a flipper, but its outside the line of impact, then the batsmen decide to sneak in a leg-bye but their communication is pathetic, both hesitating as Chawla runs forward and picks and throws back to Sangakkara, the run was never on
flatter outside off, he waits for turn and glides it to short third man, where VRV flings it back to Chawla, who doesn't get behind the stumps and allows one
tossed up on the stumps and he on-drives wide of midwicket
drives from his crease and misses, another good take from Sangakkara

rush of blood sends him back inside, but thats a good catch from Yuvraj! Afridi loses his marbles, heaving at one and getting a top-edge up into the starry night, Yuvraj keeps his eyes trained on the ball in the covers and takes it, falling down onto his back, then juggling and holding onto it on the third attempt
there he goes, clubbing it across from just outside off stump for a big six over deep midwicket, one leg up as is his wont
a touch too straight and he shuffles, on-driving for a single
bowled wider outside off stump and he drives from the crease, missing, and thats well kept by Sangakkara, standing up to the stumps
on middle and leg and Sharma clips that to midwicket, who fields
too short and at that pace it just sits up, allowing Afridi to pull finer than what Sharma did, uppish though it was, past the man at square leg
short on the stumps but Sharma pirouettes very well, importantly making sure to keep the ball down, and he picks the gap at square leg, Chawla fields in the deep
change of pace, back of a length, but he waits and dabs it to third man
slips out as a loose full toss outside off stump but Afridi can't connect
a touch too wide and he drives on the up past mid-off down to the fielder
fullish on off stump and he drives off the front foot, but Pathan fields well
change of pace but he checks the shot past the bowler to long-off
bang, thats four! VRV drops short again but this time Sharma sizes him up and clubs him over midwicket, initially coming forward but getting back superbly
full on off stump and he drives along the ground to extra-cover
banged in short, Sharma opens the face as he gets onto the toes, running it down to the right of Jayawardene at slip, who dives and saves a boundary
he likes the width and hammers it along the turf to Pathan at deep cover
back of a length on the stumps and its driven to midwicket easily

thats a big wicket, and so softly done! Chawla gets a second, flighting it up in the air and getting it to dip on Laxman, who is beaten in the flight and early into the stroke, which is chipped to Yuvraj in the covers, who pops up and takes it on the second attempt
quicker one spins into him and he gets bat down to nudge to midwicket
flighted fuller and he uses his feet to drive out to the cover sweeper
flighted on a length, it stops and the batsman plays it back to Chawla
short of a length and he drives on the up to the man at cover
short on the stumps and Laxman transfers the weight, pulling low past midwicket out to Pathan on the ropes, who fields miserably to let the ball by
short of a length and Sharma gets across to play it straight to point
not a shot he'd be proud of but its runs, Laxman reaching out and working it ungainly past mid-on down to Goel again
better length and it stops on Laxman, who nearly taps it back to VRV
low full toss and he flicks it across the line with plenty of bottom hand, and the man running around from long-on, Goel, has to dive to stop the boundary
shorter one gets him up onto the toes, working it to midwicket
short of a length and thats a lovely back-foot punch into the covers
but thats taken, as Gibbs fails to curb his enthusiasm and slogs that out into the hands of a lurking deep midwicket sweeper, who didn't have to do much on the ropes
dropped but that was very hard and flat to midwicket, where Marsh dives across the turf and fails to latch onto a scorching pull shot, Chawla dropped short and Laxman belted that very hard
quicker one, spins in and cramps Gibbs, who gets a thin inside-edge
flatter trajectory, lands short and Gibbs rocks back to cut into the covers
flighted up, he reaches out and plays across the line to midwicket
flighted up a tad too full and he paddles from middle and off down the pads
good length but a touch wide and he drives on the up to point
good shot from Gibbs, pushing uppishly past extra cover and it takes some good chasing down from Yuvraj to haul it in near the ropes
on the pads and he whips that down to deep backward square leg
edged just wide of a diving Sangakkara, Laxman flashing off the back foot and looking on thankfully as the ball deviates away from a leaping 'keeper for four
this one's shorter and stops on him, he shapes to work it across the line but it goes in the air to mid-on, landing safely before the man there
too full outside off stump and Laxman deals with as best he knows, getting to the pitch and caressing it all along the ground past extra cover, excellent
another slower ball outside off, pushed to point and Gibbs harries down
just outside off stump and Laxman works it across the line uneasily, reaching out, but mid-on makes a mess of his dive and allows the ball to go past him
slower ball goes awry, looping out well wide of off stump for a freebie
steps out and mistimes the slog along the ground to mid-on, who's deep
slashes off the front foot and Marsh dives around at backward point, sticking out a hand to save runs and his effort is well appreciated by Sreesanth
good length and he closes the face of the bat as he drives hard from the crease, the ball goes to midwicket and he sets off, panting to get to the other end and is let off by a miss from the fielder
short outside off and he punches elegantly off the back foot to point
tries to dab a shorter one to gully but the ball comes onto him slower than expected and he ends up chopping to backward point
good length, pitching and swinging away not too far outside off stump as Gibbs gets the front foot forward and holds back the bat with a twirl
slower ball, looking for the yorker, jammed back down to Pathan's left, who dives and half stops it but they cross for a single to mid-off
back of a length and Gibbs is away in the IPL with a push into the covers, where Marsh slides around and fields well
thats a wide as Pathan pitches it up and moves it miles outside off stump

bowled 'em! Gilchrist was superb in the last game as Laxman was an onlooker, but he fails tonight, just swinging from his crease with zero footwork to one pitched up and swinging in, and the ball makes contact underneath his bat to send Pathan into his jig
good length, but Laxman stays on the back foot and tries to drive, mistiming the shot back to Pathan, who fumbles and allows a single to midwicket
short of a length this time and he softly taps that past a diving backward point to keep hold of the scoring
change of pace, but a tad too full on off stump and Laxman just flicks that superbly past mid-on, nothing more than a push, and the ball greets the boundary, wow!
short of a length on off stump and thats a typical Laxman flick, supple of wrist, to an alert midwicket
drives hard from his crease, eying extra-cover, but gets too much bottom hand and ends up dragging it past midwicket, but  he gets a triple for his efforts
back of a length on the stumps and he works it to mid-on for one more
a tad full and Gilchrist drives firmly to the man at mid-off for one
this one's on a length and he flicks from off stump to midwicket
good grief, and then he goes and does that! A flowing, textbook cover-drive on the up between two men and the ball speeds away again, all class
and he follows up with an ugly drive from the crease, front foot nowhere close to the pitch of the ball, to keep Sangakkara and slip interested
don't bowl to this man there, boss! On the pads and Laxman only has to roll the wrists delicately to send the ball speeding across the outfield between square leg and midwicket
good ball, pitching on a length and swinging in to catch a clueless Gilchrist rooted to his crease, lucky to survive with an inside-edge past leg stump
and he begins with a full toss on leg stump, which is patted to midwicket

edged and dropped! Sreesanth invites another booming drive outside the off and Laxman obliges, with absolutely no footwork, and as the ball deviates he edges but Sangakkara, flinging himself to his right, cannot hold on as the ball travels away from him, thats a life for Laxman
another flowing shot, this time an off-drive, on the up, which is fielded by a diving extra-cover, robbing Laxman of four more
now there's a shot! Sreesanth pitches it up on middle and leg and Laxman unfurls a lovely flick past midwicket, and he does make a living out playing such beauties
some swing now, gently, as Sreesanth pitches full outside off stump and Laxman, as he would during day one, session three of a Test match, shoulders arms
full and wide, a loose one, and Gilchrist reaches out to slash it upwards of gully and it dribbles down to Pathan at third man
good length there, and the ball comes onto the bat nicely as Gilchrist stands his ground and pushes it to point
all over, and what a shot to finish it! Jayawardene backs away and drives the ball superbly over extra cover, all inside-out, to clinch a seven-wicket win
well its flicked off the pads to Ojha at deep square leg, so thats one
full toss, he doesn't time it well but swings a single to extra cover
that one swings well wide of the stumps to lower the equation
pitches just outside leg, swings in, and Marsh is beaten on the attempted flick but scampers a quick single to gully at Jayawardene's insistence, off the inside-edge
yorker-length delivery outside off stump, steered to short third man
and he's spanked the pants off that one! Marsh clears the front leg and goes downtown in style, clubbing Zoysa for a straight six to end the over
now its a pick-up shot over mid-on's head, dropping in no-man's-land
slants down the pads, the inside-edgenarrowly misses hitting leg stump
tries to pull a short one but takes it on the arm and it goes nowhere
exposes all three stumps, then drops the ball safely along the ground towards short third man for yet another easy single, so coolly
full down leg stump and he clips it to short fine leg for a single
steps out to leg and tucks the last ball to midwicket to keep strike
well bowled, tight on the stumps but Jayawardene just pushes it to deep mid-on for an easy single as runs keep ticking over
low full toss, he reaches out and slaps it past backward point
good length on the stumps and he plays it back towards Bangar
another streaky shot, Marsh swiping across the line and inside-edging past leg stump for the ball to dribble down to the fine-leg boundary
too short and Jayawardene cuts past point out to the sweeper
full again, Jayawardene dabs to extra cover, there's some hesitation but he harries down to the other end and evades the throw from the fielder
now he gets a low full toss and clips it past mid-on for a single
fortuitous! Marsh plays a good ol agricultural swipe and survives with a french cut past leg stump that Gilchrist has no chance of stopping
short on the stumps, he shuffles and turns if off the hips for one
firm shot to a fuller one, worked with good use of the wrists past mid-on and he  pushes Marsh to come back for the second as Ojha is slow to react in the deep
back of a length, cramping Marsh for room as he attempts a cut but still he places it just wide of the fielder for a quick single
short down leg stump, Marsh goes pulling but doesn't connect and thats something Hyderabad can do without, a free run to the opposition
there we have the first six of the Punjab innings, as Jayawardene again gets across and pulls off a rather superb scoop over fine leg, top shot
looks to walk across, Kalyankrishna sees him and pitches outside off stump, Jayawardene misses out on the cut, you could say its a hard call from the umpire because the batsman walked across
changes the length, Jayawardene sees it early and opens the face to run it down to short third man, who slides and parries the ball away behind Gilchrist
too full, too wide and Jayawardene cashes in with a pleasing drive on the up, very hard, past the man at extra cover
attempting a yorker he pitches wide and Marsh squeezes it past two men at cover and point, well placed shot again from him
back of a length outside off and he pushes it to point for one
and thats a top shot to a full toss, just getting across to produce the paddle-scoop over short fine leg
and that beats him, nipping in with extra height, a top over comes to an end
back of a length on middle and off, just worked to midwicket
gets tall and drives off the back foot straight to Gibbs at point
fractionally short, he makes room and cuts to short third man
again its back of a length but this time he adjusts and coolly pushes it to backward point, firmly in control is Marsh
back of a length outside off stump and Marsh drives to mid-on
short again, transfers his weight and drives down to long-on
comes down, Afridi fires it in and Marsh digs it back to him
looped up on middle and leg and its easily nudged to the on-side
fizzed up on middle and off, he gets back and plays it to midwicket
pushed through fuller and he reaches out to dab it to backward point
again, too short and Marsh just gets back to muscle it away with a horizontal bat perfectly between midwicket and square leg and the ball speeds away, amazing batting from young Marsh
gets cheeky and late-cuts to a diving gully, who flings around and gets a hand on it after it bounces in front of him, but cant stop it from escaping for four
full toss which he cannot put past the bowler and cover
slower ball, a touch too wide, Jayawardene gets onto bended knee and square-drives superbly to beat a diving Gibbs at backward point as well as the sweeper out on the boundary
well played, running it off the open face to backward point, who tumbles around and does well to save runs
nips into him and he rolls the wrists, playing it to midwicket
pitches just outside leg and Marsh misses it, they all appeal but the umpire walks away as the batsmen scamper a leg-bye to short third man
Sri Lankan to Sri Lankan, Zoysa drops too short and Jayawardene swivels to pull that in the air safely wide of square leg for a first-ball four

and thats the end of that! Yuvraj shapes to pull another short one but it sits up a tad more than expected and he makes a meal of the timing as the ball gains on him, succeeding only in lobbing the simples of return catches to Zoysa, Hyderabad know all too well how big that is
cleanly struck! Zoysa drops in too short and Yuvraj clubs him past mid-on
full in the blockhole and its punched down towards long-on
this time he heaves across the line at a short one and misses it
and that will be his fifty with a pick-up shot over midwicket, lovely use of the wrists as the bowler pitches it up in his zone, well played Marsh, another Aussie shines in the IPL
a tad too straight and it allows Marsh to wrist it away to midwicket
short again, but this one stops on Yuvraj as he chips it off the back foot in the air, safely past mid-on for a single
gives it some air and now Marsh coolly tucks it to midwicket
a rank half-tracker and Marsh deals with it, spanking past cover for four
too full now and Yuvraj clips it out to deep midwicket for one
too short outside off stump and its pulled down to Zoysa at long-on
good length but on leg stump and another easy single for Punjab
short on off stump, he makes room and steers that to backward point
short of a length on off, gets him back and across, driving to Bangar
this is poor stuff, bowling it well outside leg stump and Marsh escorts the ball down to fine leg for another well-timed boundary
marginally short on off stump but Marsh plays an excellent flick past midwicket, airborne and using a strong bottom hand to wrist it away for four
overpitched on off stump and Marsh plays a pleasing straight drive, which is well stopped down the ground by RP Singh, sliding around
gets some width and inside-edges from outside off down past leg
full and flat on the stumps and he now flicks to midwicket
shorter one and he rocks back to punch that sweetly past cover, awesome
flat outside leg again and this time he flicks to midwicket
flat outside leg stump, Marsh tries to sweep and misses, they ask the question but umpire Doctrove is unmoved
full, wide and Marsh steers that past backward point for a couple
comes onto the front foot and punches this one straight to cover
a very wide delivery outside off, Yuvraj chases but cant get there
got em! Sangakkara falls going for an expansive drive off one knee, just failing to keep the ball down and Sharma takes an easy catch at cover
back of a length on off stump and Marsh turns that wide of midwicket
gets forward and drives that firmly to the fielder at mid-off
full on the pads, he shuffles and turns it past square leg for two
good length and Sangakkara drives it back on the bounce
unfortunate for Punjab, as Marsh drills a full one dead straight and Bangar gets a finger on the ball to ricochet it onto the nonstriker's stumps with Sarwan well outside his crease
thats a better length and Marsh works it across the line to Sharma
straight on middle and off and its pushed to midwicket, as he shuffles
drags it from outside off stump and gets a single to midwicket, where Sharma dives but cant stop it, so mid-on fires in a throw which is well backed up
now he tries to tee off, driving over extra cover on the up, not timing it well at all but he's lucky it lands safely in the deep
very full outside off stump, Marsh jams it down to backward point
now he slips in the fuller delivery and Marsh drags it from outside off stump, rather aggressively and with plenty of bottom hand, to square leg
change of pace and length, slipping into Marsh's ribs at some good height and he's cramped for room, allowing the ball to come onto him, taking it in the midriff
this one's too short and Sarwan slashes wide of gully to third man
good length delivery outside off stump, Sarwan plays an odd sort of shot off the back foot back past Zoysa to mid-on
too short and he pulls it very hard out to deep square leg on the bounce
pitches outside leg and he works it off the pads to square leg
better delivery, back of a length, nips in very straight and Marsh survives with an inside-edge, shuffling across the stumps
short on the stumps, sits up, he pulls of one leg but cops the ball in his midriff, it drops near the stumps and they don't risk the single
more width and Sarwan reaches out, slashing on the bounce to third man
full now and Sarwan's onto the front foot, square-driving safely for four
offers Sarwan width but he can't cash in, mistiming the cut to slip
looks for swing and pitches full, Sarwan drives on the up to point
now he drops short and Marsh spanks that past backward point
top shot, just a checked straight-drive that beats mid-on, lovely
a touch fuller this time and Sarwan drives with a flourish to extra cover
quicker, flatter, Sarwan cuts and gets a thick bottom-edge that drops into the ground and rolls to Laxman at slip
outside leg stump and Marsh eases that off the pads to square leg
looped up on leg stump, Sarwan nudges the ball to midwicket
bowls it fuller and Sarwan's onto the front foot, driving down to mid-off
third ball in a row, short, and Sarwan opens his account with a firm cut in front of square and into the gap for a nice boundary
gets up and cuts again, this time hitting just in front of Gibbs at point
and he misses, cutting too close to the body, as Zoysa hits a length
gets some room, checks the shot, running wide of backward point
good length on off stump, hint of swing, worked towards midwicket
short on the stumps and he tucks it off the hips to square leg
full again, very full, and he squeezes it through backward point, down to third man who fumbles and allows Marsh come back for the second, to RP's frustration
gets more room and punches off the back foot past point, sweetly
short of a length and he defends to point, getting tall in his crease
this time he connects, leaning into a full one and lacing past cover
and he's beaten first ball, reaching out and trying to drive a full one
